reason: A carved wooden design seems useful for the printing press.
expectation: I expect the chisel to carve a printing block from the planks, though it may make another press component.

alternatives.reason: Charcoal and water might make ink, but I want to prepare the carved design first.

effect: The carved block is ready; combining it with iron may advance the press itself.
reason: I want to build the press around the printing block.
expectation: I expect the iron to add a mechanism or frame to the block, though the exact result is uncertain.

alternatives.reason: Charcoal and water may make ink, but building the press is the current goal.

effect: The press is built, and the new goal is to print a page; its description suggests the block needs ink.
reaction: The screw mechanism makes the combination clearer.
reason: Charcoal and water seem likely to make ink for printing.
expectation: I expect an ink or pigment mixture, though I am not certain.

alternatives.reason: The press and paper are needed for a page, but I expect ink is needed first.

effect: Ink is ready, so I can prepare the press for printing.
reason: The press description says the block is inked before paper is pressed against it.
expectation: I expect to ink the printing block or prepare the press for printing.

alternatives.reason: Paper is needed for the page, but inking the press seems like the next step.

effect: The press is inked and ready for paper, so I can print the page.
reaction: The explanation makes the next step clear.
reason: The only offered combination applies paper to the inked press.

effect: The printed pages complete the goal and show how the press reproduces an illustration.
reaction: Seeing the design copied onto multiple sheets is a satisfying payoff.

mostWorthwhile.text: Building the press was most worthwhile because its description explained how the screw and plate work together.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making ink was predictable, though it served a clear purpose.

surprise.text: The iron became a screw mechanism in a timber frame; I had not known the exact construction.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary; each contributed to making or using the press.

continue.text: I would probably continue for another chapter to see another process explained through its components, though the offered combinations made the decisions fairly straightforward.
